description.narrative: The problems arise from deprivation, unemployment and social neglect. The project will provide funding for the employment of local staff, centre operations and management, in addition to fund the induction programme initiatives. Programmes will focus on six pillars, health, welfare, education, life skills and leadership and sports development. With a further mechanism for income generation and business development. These areas will help to create and support existing partnerships with local schools, encourage a broader educational agenda, and support the financial management of the centre, in addition to providing loans and increasing entrepreneurial skills. Through a series of workshop children and youth will be exposed to sports skills, life and leadership skills and coach training courses. The centre will also encourage and support the development and training of local staff, community volunteers and create a forum through which on-going partnerships can flourish. These programming initiatives will include the following: the establishment of leagues; drop-in centre for use by the community; safe, secure environment within which activities can take place; increased female participation in sport; increased access for local community schools to sporting programmes not offered in the legislated curriculum; increased access to social welfare services, information and technology.
